# Course audit
```{r}
# Scup School project audit ------------------------------------------------
#
#The audit should answer four questions:
#
#  1. Does the manifest match the filesystem?
#  2. Do page metadata and generated structures match the manifest?
#  3. Are internal links valid?
#  4. How much placeholder content remains?
#
#
# Read-only validation.
# Does not modify project files.
#
# Usage:
#
# source("dev/audit-project.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
# audit_project()
#
# After a Quarto render:
#
# audit_project(check_rendered = TRUE)

source(
  "dev/audit-project.R",
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

audit_project(
  check_rendered = TRUE
)

```


# manifest update after module 2
```{r}
manifest_path <- "dev/course-manifest.csv"

manifest <- read.csv(
  manifest_path,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Safety checks -------------------------------------------------------------

module_2 <- manifest$module_number == 2

stopifnot(sum(module_2) == 11)

expected_ids <- sprintf(
  "m02-p%02d",
  0:10
)

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    manifest$page_id[module_2],
    expected_ids
  )
)

stopifnot(
  sum(manifest$page_id == "m02-p09") == 1
)


# Module 2 is now integrated ------------------------------------------------

manifest$content_status[module_2] <- "ready"

manifest$page_title[
  manifest$page_id == "m02-p09"
] <- "2. meeting – Problémák közös feltérképezése"


# Save ----------------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  manifest,
  manifest_path,
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na = ""
)


# Show exactly what Module 2 now says ---------------------------------------

manifest[
  module_2,
  c(
    "page_order",
    "page_id",
    "page_type",
    "page_title",
    "content_status"
  )
]
```

# Module 3 sync
```{r}
manifest <- read.csv(
  "dev/course-manifest.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

m3 <- manifest[manifest$module_number == 3, ]

yaml_quote <- function(x) {
  paste0('"', gsub('"', '\\"', x, fixed = TRUE), '"')
}

set_yaml_key <- function(lines, key, value) {
  delimiters <- which(trimws(lines) == "---")

  if (length(delimiters) < 2 || delimiters[1] != 1) {
    stop("Invalid YAML front matter.")
  }

  yaml_end <- delimiters[2]

  positions <- which(
    grepl(
      paste0("^", key, "\\s*:"),
      lines
    )
  )

  positions <- positions[
    positions > 1 & positions < yaml_end
  ]

  new_line <- paste0(key, ": ", value)

  if (length(positions) > 1) {
    stop("Duplicate YAML key: ", key)
  }

  if (length(positions) == 1) {
    lines[positions] <- new_line
  } else {
    lines <- append(
      lines,
      new_line,
      after = yaml_end - 1
    )
  }

  lines
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(m3))) {
  row <- m3[i, ]
  path <- row$relative_path

  lines <- readLines(
    path,
    warn = FALSE,
    encoding = "UTF-8"
  )

  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "title",
    yaml_quote(row$page_title)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "page-id",
    yaml_quote(row$page_id)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "page-type",
    yaml_quote(row$page_type)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "module-number",
    as.character(row$module_number)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "module-title",
    yaml_quote(row$module_title)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "page-order",
    as.character(row$page_order)
  )
  lines <- set_yaml_key(
    lines, "content-status",
    yaml_quote(row$content_status)
  )

  writeLines(
    lines,
    path,
    useBytes = TRUE
  )
}

message("Module 3 front matter synchronized.")
```
